---
name: Device report
about: Tell us whether NeoXR works with your glasses and phone
title: "[Device] "
labels: device-report
---

**Glasses**
Model and firmware version (for example: XREAL One Pro, firmware 1.2.3).

**Phone**
Model and Android version.

**What works**
- [ ] Video plays on the glasses (phone becomes the controller)
- [ ] Touchpad and pointer work
- [ ] 3D SBS looks correct (no double image, no stretching)
- [ ] Head tracking (the `Head` button in the player)

**What does not work**
Describe what you see. Screenshots or a photo through the glasses help a lot.

**Anything else**
Connection type (direct USB-C or a hub), any VPN running on the phone, and
whether Stabilizer is off / Follow mode is on in the glasses menu.
